paragraphs: Pinterest is an AI-powered visual search and discovery platform, positioned at the intersection of search, social, and commerce. We offer a unique and differentiated experience that enables people to go from inspiration to action all on one consumer internet property. Pinterest can be accessed through our mobile application or the web.

People use Pinterest to find useful, relevant ideas—and then bring them to life. People don't always have the words to describe what they're looking for, but often know it when they see it. As they browse Pinterest content (called "Pins"), they fine-tune their tastes and find the perfect idea. Users interact with the platform in dynamic multi-session journeys to find inspiration, curate their latest look, plan their next project and shop from great brands. This happens at a massive scale, with billions of searches and saves per month, with the vast majority of queries being visual.

The unique, first party, intent-based signal we receive from user actions on Pinterest helps power the AI based recommendation systems that we use to surface relevant and engaging content to our users.

AI also plays a central role in how we drive value for our advertisers, who come to Pinterest to reach our users with high commercial intent. The inspiration-to-action journey on Pinterest aligns with the advertiser marketing funnel, allowing us to help brands reach customers at every stage, from discovery to purchase, through digital ads.

We believe users and advertisers intentionally choose Pinterest because of our efforts to create a positive and more brand safe environment. As a result, we make deliberate decisions through our policies and product development and aim to deliver on that experience, creating value for advertisers who can showcase their product and services in an inspiring and positive environment.

619 million monthly active users from around the world come to Pinterest to find new ideas, curate and refine their tastes, and turn those ideas into reality. Our platform particularly resonates with women, who comprise roughly two-thirds of our total user base. In addition, our platform also resonates with the younger generation, as Gen Z users represent over 50% of our user base. Geographically, we have a diverse user set, representing over 100 countries globally.

Content on Pinterest comes from a variety of sources, including retailers, brands, creators, publishers and users. We acquire that content via a wide range of methods including product catalog uploads, direct publishing, and user curation. Content formats include images that allow you to click into an idea to learn more, videos that provide the steps of an idea, collages that allow users to piece together different images into one, and products that brands and merchants upload from catalogs.

On Pinterest, users interact with several surfaces, each of which offers distinct functionalities and experiences. Users often move between these surfaces various times in a single session and across multiple sessions. Saving content and creating boards and collages are highly unique and beneficial to our ecosystem. This curation activity generates signals across a network of many billions of associations between Pins, searches, boards, products and users on our platform. Together, these connections comprise our valuable Taste Graph and help us serve users even more relevant content recommendations.

Home Feed: When users open the Pinterest mobile application or navigate to www.pinterest.com, they are by default in their Home Feed, where they can discover Pins relevant to their tastes and interests in a scrolling format. As users interact with more content - through searching, saving and curating - their Home Feed is designed to become even more representative of their interests.

Search Page: On the Search surface, users find Pins they are looking for by typing a query in the search bar. The search functionality allows users to see many relevant possibilities that are personalized for their individual taste

and interests. Users often come to Pinterest with a vague idea of what they're looking for and use our visual search functionality to narrow their focus. As such, over 90% of our searches are unbranded.

Related Pins: Visual discovery on Pinterest also happens when a user taps on a Pin to learn more about an idea or image, and a feed of visually similar Pins is served beneath the tapped image. These related Pins help users springboard off a point of inspiration to explore deeper into an interest or narrow in on the perfect product. Our related pins surface is powered by our recommendation models that use computer vision designed to identify products in the Pin and show other relevant organic or ads content that the user might find valuable to their inspiration to action journey.

Boards: Users save and organize Pins onto virtual "boards." Boards often are labeled with topical categories like "Hawaiian vacation," "spring outfits" or "living room furniture" and are a collection of Pins that help users organize the vast amount of visual content that they interact with on the platform.

paragraphs: Investing in our Class A common stock involves a high degree of risk. In addition to the other information set forth in this Annual Report, you should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section titled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our consolidated financial statements and related notes, before making an investment decision with respect to our Class A common stock. Some of the factors, events, and contingencies discussed below may have occurred in the past, but the disclosures below are not representations as to whether or not the factors, events or contingencies have occurred in the past, and instead reflect our beliefs and opinions as to the factors, events, or contingencies that could materially and adversely affect us in the future. The occurrence of any of the following risks and uncertainties could in circumstances we may or may not be able to accurately predict, materially and adversely affect our business and operations, growth, prospects, reputation, revenue, financial results, financial condition, cash flows, liquidity and stock price. It is not possible to predict or identify all such risks and uncertainties; our business could also be affected by risks and uncertainties that are not presently known to us or that we currently believe are immaterial. Therefore, you should not consider the following risks to be a complete statement of all the potential risks or uncertainties that we face.
Risks Related to Our Business Strategy and Growth

Substantially all of our revenue is generated from third-party advertising. However, we may not be able to continue to grow and scale this revenue model. Our growth strategy depends on, among other things, attracting more advertisers (including expanding our sales efforts to reach advertisers in international markets), retaining and scaling our business with existing advertisers and expanding our advertising product offerings.

As is common in our industry, most of our advertisers do not have long-term advertising commitments with us. Many of our advertisers spend a relatively small portion of their overall advertising budget with us. To increase the number of advertisers and increase the portion of the advertising budget that our existing advertisers spend with us, we must invest in new tools and technology and/or expand our sales force, and there can be no assurance that those efforts will be successful. The insights on user behavior we provide to advertisers may not yield effective results for the advertisers and as a result, they may reduce or stop their spend on our platform. In addition, unless we improve existing and develop new measurement tools that better showcase our platform's effectiveness, some advertisers may view our products or platform as experimental and may devote less advertising spend on our platform. In addition, many advertisers do not have advertising creative content in a format that would be successful on our platform and may be unable or unwilling to devote the technical or financial resources required to develop content for our platform. Further, we may not always be able to develop tools that effectively and efficiently meet the needs of advertisers. Advertisers will not do business with us if they do not believe that advertisements on our platform are effective in meeting their campaign goals, if we cannot measure the effectiveness of our advertising products or if they do not believe that their investment in advertising with us will generate a competitive return relative to other alternatives.

A substantial portion of our revenue is derived from a small number of advertisers and is currently concentrated in certain verticals, particularly retail and CPG. We either contract directly with advertisers or with advertising agencies on behalf of advertisers, many of which are owned by large media corporations that exercise varying degrees of control over the agencies. Our business, revenue and financial results could be harmed by the loss of, or a deterioration in our relationship with, any of our largest advertisers or with any advertising agencies or the large media corporations that control them.

In addition, a portion of our revenue is derived from partnerships with third-party advertising platforms. We may be unable to maintain these partnerships or identify and secure new partnerships on commercially reasonable terms. In addition, we may be exposed to reputational and other risks arising from our business association with these partners.

Monthly Active Users. We define an MAU as an authenticated Pinterest user who visits our website, opens our mobile application or interacts with Pinterest through one of our browser or site extensions, such as the Save button, at least once during the 30-day period ending on the date of measurement. The number of MAUs does not include Shuffles users unless they would otherwise qualify as MAUs. We present MAUs based on the number of MAUs measured on the last day of the current period. We calculate average MAUs based on the average of the number of MAUs measured on the last day of the current period and the last day prior to the beginning of the current period. MAUs are the primary metric by which we measure the scale of our active user base.
Note: U.S. and Canada, Europe and Rest of World may not sum to Global due to rounding. Europe includes Russia and Turkey for our reporting of Revenue, MAUs and ARPU by geographic region.

A portion of our MAUs visit Pinterest on a weekly basis. We define a weekly active user ("WAU") as an authenticated Pinterest user who visits our website, opens our mobile application or interacts with Pinterest through one of our browser or site extensions, such as the Save button, at least once during the seven-day period ending on the date of measurement. As of December 31, 2025, the proportion of WAUs to MAUs, which has stayed relatively consistent over time, was 62%.
Pinterest 是一個由人工智慧驅動的視覺搜尋與發現平台，定位於搜尋、社交與購物的交會點。我們提供獨特且有差異化的體驗，使使用者能從靈感轉化為行動，皆在一個消費者網路平台上完成。Pinterest 可透過我們的行動應用程式或網頁存取。

使用者使用 Pinterest 來尋找有用且相關的點子，並將其付諸實踐。使用者不總是擁有描述他們尋找之物的詞彙，但往往在看到時便能辨識。當他們瀏覽 Pinterest 內容（稱為 "Pins"）時，會精準化自己的品味並找到完美的點子。使用者透過動態的多階段會話與平台互動，以尋找靈感、整理他們最新的風格、計畫下一個專案並從優質品牌購物。這一切規模龐大，每月進行數十億次搜尋與儲存，其中絕大多數的查詢為視覺查詢。
我們從使用者在 Pinterest 上的行動所獲得的獨特、第一方、意圖導向的信號，有助於驅動我們使用的基於人工智慧的推薦系統，以呈現與使用者相關且具吸引力的內容。
人工智慧也在我們為廣告主創造價值的方式中扮演核心角色，廣告主來到 Pinterest 是為了與具有高商業意圖的使用者接觸。Pinterest 上的靈感至行動旅程與廣告主的行銷漏斗相呼應，使我們能協助品牌在每個階段，從發現到購買，透過數位廣告接觸消費者。
我們相信使用者與廣告主有意識地選擇 Pinterest，是因為我們努力創造一個正面且更品牌安全的環境。因此，我們透過政策與產品開發做出有意識的決定，並致力於提供此體驗，為廣告主創造價值，使其能在啟發性與正面的環境中展示其產品與服務。
來自世界各地的 6.19 億月活躍使用者來到 Pinterest 以尋找新點子、整理與精煉他們的品味，並將這些點子轉化為現實。我們的平台特別受到女性歡迎，女性約佔我們總使用者數的三分之二。此外，我們的平台也與年輕世代產生共鳴，因為 Z 世代使用者佔我們使用者數的過半數。從地理上來說，我們的使用者組成多元，代表全球超過 100 個國家。
Pinterest 上的內容來自多種來源，包括零售商、品牌、創作者、出版者與使用者。我們透過多種方式取得這些內容，包括產品目錄上傳、直接發佈與使用者整理。內容格式包括圖片，允許使用者點擊點子以瞭解更多信息、影片提供點子的步驟、拼貼讓使用者將不同圖片組合成一張，以及品牌與販售者從目錄上傳的產品。
在 Pinterest 上，使用者會與多種介面互動，每個介面皆提供獨特的功能與體驗。使用者經常在單一會話中或跨多個會話中在這些介面間移動。儲存內容與建立板與拼貼是高度獨特且對我們生態繫有益的。此整理活動會在平台上的許多十億個關聯網路中產生信號，這些關聯包括 Pins、搜尋、板、產品與使用者。這些連接共同組成我們寶貴的 Taste Graph，並幫助我們為使用者提供更相關的內容推薦。
Home Feed: 當使用者開啟 Pinterest 的行動應用程式或導覽至 www.pinterest.com 時，預設會進入 Home Feed，他們可以在滾動式格式中發現與其喜好和興趣相關的 Pins。隨著使用者與更多內容互動 - 透過搜尋、儲存和整理 - 其 Home Feed 被設計為更能反映其興趣。
Search Page: 在搜尋介面，使用者透過在搜尋欄位輸入查詢來尋找他們尋找的 Pins。搜尋功能允許使用者看到許多與其個人喜好和興趣相關的相關結果。
and interests. 使用者常常在 Pinterest 上帶著模糊的想法來尋找他們想要的東西，並使用我們的視覺搜尋功能來縮小範圍。因此，我們超過 90% 的搜尋為非品牌搜尋。

Related Pins: 在 Pinterest 上，視覺發現也發生在使用者點擊一個 Pin 以瞭解一個想法或圖片時，並在點擊的圖片下方顯示視覺上相似的 Pins。這些相關 Pins 幫助使用者從一個靈感點跳躍，深入探索興趣或鎖定完美的產品。我們的相關 Pins 顯示功能由我們的推薦模型驅動，這些模型使用電腦視覺技術來識別 Pin 中的產品，並顯示其他相關的自然或廣告內容，這些內容可能對使用者的靈感到行動旅程有價值。
Boards: 使用者將 Pins 儲存並整理至虛擬的 "boards"。這些 Boards 通常會標籤為主題類別，例如 "夏威夷假期"、"春季穿搭" 或 "客廳傢俱"，並是一組 Pins，幫助使用者整理在平台上互動的大量視覺內容。

每月活躍使用者。我們將活躍使用者（MAU）定義為已驗證的Pinterest使用者，在30天內於測量日期前的期間內至少一次造訪我們的網站、開啟我們的行動應用程式或透過瀏覽器或網站擴充功能（例如儲存按鈕）與Pinterest互動。MAU數量不包含Shuffles使用者，除非他們本質上符合MAU的條件。我們根據當前期間最後一天測量的MAU數量來呈現MAU。我們根據當前期間最後一天及當前期間開始前的前一個期間最後一天測量的MAU數量的平均值來計算平均MAU。MAU是我們衡量活躍使用者規模的主要指標。
注意：美國與加拿大、歐洲與其餘地區的數字可能因四捨五入而不會總計為全球數字。歐洲地區包含俄羅斯與土耳其，用於我們按地理區域報告收入、MAU與ARPU。
我們MAU中的一部分使用者每週會造訪Pinterest。我們將週活躍使用者（"WAU"）定義為已驗證的Pinterest使用者，在測量日期前的七天內至少一次造訪我們的網站、開啟我們的行動應用程式或透過瀏覽器或網站擴充功能（例如儲存按鈕）與Pinterest互動。截至2025年12月31日，WAU與MAU的比例為62%，此比例在過去的時間中大致保持穩定。

paragraphs: 投資本公司 A 級普通股涉及高度風險。除本年度報告中所列其他資訊外，您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，並配合本年度報告 10-K 表格中所有其他資訊，包括「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」一節以及我們合併財務報表及其相關附註，以做出有關本公司 A 級普通股之投資決定。部分下列所討論的因素、事件與待決事項可能已發生於過去，但下列揭露並非表示這些因素、事件或待決事項是否已發生於過去，而是反映我們對可能於未來對我們造成重大且不利影響的因素、事件或待決事項之看法。上述任何風險與不確定性之發生，可能在我們可能預測或無法預測的情況下，對我們之業務與營運、成長、前景、聲譽、營業收入、財務結果、財務狀況、現金流、流動性及股票價格造成重大且不利影響。無法預測或識別所有這些風險與不確定性；我們之業務也可能受到目前未知或我們目前認為不重要之風險與不確定性之影響。因此，您不應將下列風險視為我們所面臨所有潛在風險與不確定性之完整陳述。
與我們業務策略與成長相關之風險
我們幾乎所有之營業收入均來自第三方廣告。然而，我們可能無法持續成長與擴展此收入模式。我們之成長策略取決於多項因素，包括吸引更多廣告客戶（包括擴展銷售努力以接觸國際市場之廣告客戶）、保留並擴展與現有廣告客戶之業務，以及擴展我們之廣告產品組合。

如同我們產業常見，我們大多數廣告客戶並未與我們訂有長期廣告契約。許多廣告客戶僅將其總體廣告預算中相對較小之部分用於我們。為增加廣告客戶數量並提高現有廣告客戶於我們平台所花費之廣告預算比例，我們必須投資於新工具與技術及/或擴充銷售團隊，但無法保證這些努力會成功。我們提供給廣告客戶之用戶行為洞察可能無法產生對廣告客戶有效的結果，因此，他們可能減少或停止在我們平台之廣告支出。此外，除非我們改善現有並發展新之測量工具，以更有效地展示我們平台之成效，否則部分廣告客戶可能將我們之產品或平台視為實驗性質，並可能減少在我們平台之廣告支出。此外，許多廣告客戶並未擁有適合我們平台之廣告創意內容，且可能無法或不願投入技術或財務資源以開發內容用於我們平台。進一步而言，我們可能無法總是開發出有效且高效之工具以符合廣告客戶之需求。若廣告客戶認為我們平台之廣告無法有效達成其行銷目標，或我們無法測量廣告產品之成效，或他們認為在與我們合作之廣告投資無法相較於其他選項產生競爭性回報，則他們將不會與我們合作。
我們營業收入之相當大一部分來自少數廣告客戶，目前集中於某些產業，特別是零售與 CPG。我們或是直接與廣告客戶簽約，或是代表廣告客戶與廣告代理商簽約，許多廣告代理商為大型媒體公司所有，這些公司對代理商行使不同程度之控制權。我們之業務、營業收入與財務結果可能因失去任何最大廣告客戶，或與任何廣告代理商或控制這些代理商之大型媒體公司之關係惡化而受到損害。
此外，我們營業收入之一部分來自與第三方廣告平台之合作。我們可能無法維持這些合作關係，或識別並取得新合作關係於商業合理條款下。此外，我們可能因與這些合作夥伴之業務關係而面臨聲譽及其他風險。
